extension_description.message: Floating up/down buttons on any page: click to flip, hold to scroll, right-click for top/bottom; 36 styles, per-site exclusion.

popup_unavailable_hint.message: Browser internal pages can't be excluded

popup_off_hint.message: Click to re-enable; manage the list in Settings

btn_up_title.message: Scroll up: click to flip, hold to auto-scroll, right-click for top, middle-click to close tab, Ctrl+drag to move

btn_down_title.message: Scroll down: click to flip, hold to auto-scroll, right-click for bottom, middle-click to close tab, Ctrl+drag to move

opt_sub.message: Floating up/down buttons on web pages — click to flip · hold to scroll · right-click for top/bottom

opt_power_desc.message: When off, buttons are hidden on all sites (your settings are kept)

opt_pos_hint.message: Click anywhere to place · drag to fine-tune

opt_pos_note1.message: Click anywhere in the mock page to place the buttons; drag to fine-tune.

opt_pos_note2.message: On any web page: hold Ctrl and drag the buttons; the position is saved on release.

opt_pos_note3.message: The mock page previews your style, size and opacity live.

opt_ratio_hint.message: How far one click scrolls (share of one screen)

opt_edgespeed_hint.message: Right-click jump speed to top/bottom (1.0× is standard)

opt_holdspeed_hint.message: Pixels per second while holding; stops the moment you release

opt_holddelay_hint.message: Delay before continuous scrolling starts (shorter = snappier)

opt_middle_close_hint.message: Press the middle mouse button (wheel) on a floating button to close the current tab; middle-clicks elsewhere on the page stay unaffected.

opt_idle_hint.message: Fades out a few seconds after the cursor leaves; comes back instantly when you return.

opt_fs_hint.message: Buttons hide automatically in fullscreen (videos, presentations) — always on, nothing to set up.

opt_excl_hint.message: Buttons show everywhere by default. Sites in this list (and their subdomains) are excluded — e.g. excluding zhihu.com also excludes www.zhihu.com and zhuanlan.zhihu.com.

opt_excl_placeholder.message: Domain or paste a URL, e.g. zhihu.com

opt_excl_empty.message: No excluded sites yet — buttons show on every site

opt_excl_err_invalid.message: Not a valid domain — enter one like zhihu.com, or paste a full URL

opt_xhs_ai.message: Hide the "Dian Dian" AI panel on Xiaohongshu

opt_xhs_ai_hint.message: Xiaohongshu auto-opens its "Dian Dian" AI panel while you browse (on search results, when opening a note, and elsewhere). When enabled, the panel no longer appears anywhere on Xiaohongshu (it is closed automatically). Other websites remain untouched.

opt_bak_hint.message: Settings are stored locally in this browser (no cloud sync). Export a backup before switching or reinstalling, then import it anytime.

opt_bak_exported.message: Exported: styles, position, speeds and excluded sites — keep it to restore later

opt_bak_bad_json.message: Import failed: not a valid JSON file

opt_bak_no_settings.message: Import failed: no recognizable settings found

opt_bak_read_fail.message: Import failed: could not read the file

opt_fb_hint.message: Found a problem, have a style idea or a feature request? Email me — every message is read:

opt_foot.message: · Settings save automatically and apply instantly; after an extension update, refresh open pages once.

guide_sub.message: Those two little buttons on the right side of web pages — here's everything they can do. Watch the loops, then try them on a real page.

g_click_p.message: One click smoothly flips a full screen (80% by default); rapid clicks accelerate — click three times, flip three screens.

g_hold_p.message: Press and hold to scroll steadily, like dragging a scrollbar; release or move away to stop instantly.

g_right_p.message: Right-click the up button to jump to the very top; right-click the down button to reach the very bottom.

g_drag_p.message: Hold Ctrl and drag the buttons anywhere you like with the left button; the position is saved on release.

g_middle_p.message: Press the middle mouse button (wheel) on either button to close the current tab instantly; turn it off in Settings anytime.

tip1_p.message: Fades out a few seconds after your cursor leaves, and returns instantly when you move back.

tip2_p.message: Buttons step aside automatically in fullscreen — videos and presentations stay clean.

tip3_p.message: Click the toolbar icon → disable the current site in one tap; manage the list in Settings (whole domains supported).

more_p.message: Settings include 36 styles (Solid / Gradient / Glass / Breath / Flow / Metal), circle & rounded shapes, flip distance and speed controls. Before moving computers, export a backup from “Backup & restore”.
